seo_title: Turquoise Green Glossy Wave Mosaic Tiles
meta_description: Wave mosaic tiles in glossy turquoise green glazed ceramic for feature walls, kitchen backsplashes and bathroom accents. Free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These wave mosaic tiles are glossy glazed ceramic pieces in turquoise green, cut in a curved wave outline for feature walls, kitchen backsplashes and bathroom accents.

## How they look
The wave shape gives each row a gentle curve, so a wall reads as moving water rather than a flat grid. The glossy glaze reflects light, which tends to brighten a small kitchen or bathroom, and turquoise green sits between sea blue and fresh green. Glossy tiles show water spots and fingerprints more than matte ones, so think about where the wall gets splashed.

## Where they work
- **Kitchen backsplashes**: wave shape backsplash tiles behind a sink or counter, where a glazed face is generally easy to wipe.
- **Bathroom accent walls** and shower niches.
- **Feature panels** in a lounge bar, café counter or entrance.

Keep surrounding surfaces plain so the curves stand out. These are wall tiles; they are not listed for floors.

## Good to know
- Material: glazed ceramic mosaic
- Colour: turquoise green
- Finish: glossy
- Shape: wave
- Size and sheet layout: confirm on enquiry

Turquoise green glossy tiles look their best with a level, well-prepared wall, since gloss shows unevenness. Ask your tiler about adhesive and grout near hobs and sinks, and clean with a mild, non-acid cleaner.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the colour under your own lighting, then get a dated quote for this glossy ceramic mosaic in Pakistan. Browse the [bathroom wall mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-mosaic) or read our [backsplash ideas](/blog/bathroom-and-kitchen-tiles-modern-designs-and-backsplash-ideas).

faqs.q: What is the price of wave mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are glossy mosaic tiles good for a kitchen backsplash?
faqs.a: They are a common choice because the glaze is generally simple to wipe clean of oil and splashes. Glossy surfaces do show water marks, so a quick wipe after cooking keeps them looking clean.

faqs.q: Glossy or matte mosaic: which should I pick?
faqs.a: Glossy reflects light and makes colour look brighter, which suits small or dim rooms. Matte hides marks and fingerprints better and gives a calmer look.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Turquoise Green Wave Mosaic" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
